translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

content: Nad' Santiago,

nongake' nak' wen llin c̱he Chioza' na' wen llin c̱he X̱ancho Jesucrístona', chwap' le' chiox, ka le' nakle ka shlliṉ kwen xiiṉ dia c̱he dii Israela' daa nakle lall' na' Chioza' na' neslesle doxen yell-lioni.
Le' beṉ' bish'dawaa na' le' beṉ' zandawaa, ḻi yiba yizaki kat' ile'ile yiya yeḻ' zak'zi'.
Ḻa' ba ṉezkzile kat' chzak'zi'cho daa nonḻilall'cho Chioza', chaklenan cho' soatipchcho gonḻilall'chone'.
Na' ḻi gap yeḻ' chxenlall' lao bittez daa gak c̱hele kwenc̱he yiyoll yido gakchale kon ka chazlall' Chioza'.
Shi nole chyalljile yeḻ' sin'na', ḻi iṉabin Chioza' na' goṉe'n. Ḻa' Chioza' cho'en nottezə beṉ' chṉabe'n, aga no chllonile'n.
Ḻi iṉaban na' ḻi gonyeṉ' lez goṉe'n na' bi gakc̱hoplall'le. Ḻa' beena' chonc̱hoplall' nake' ka bḻi c̱he nisdo'na' daa choa' be'na' to ni to na'lə.
Beena' chakc̱hoplall', bi gone' lez we' X̱ancho Chioza' daa chṉabe',
ḻa' chiya dii na yic̱hjlall'do'ena' gone', na' shaḻ' ki shaḻ' ka'lə chake' lao yog'ḻoḻ daa chone'.
Beṉ' bish'chona', beena' nak beṉ' yesh'do', chiyaḻ' yiba yizakile' daa nake' beṉ' zakii lao Chioza'.
Na' beṉ' bish'chona', beena' nak beṉ' wni'a, chiyaḻ' yibaile' daa ba biyakbe'ile' aga no nake' lao Chioza'. Ḻa' ka chde c̱he yejdo'ka' llia lyix̱aa ka'kzan te c̱he beṉ' wni'aka'.
Kat' chla' wbilldo'na' na' chṉa'n zi'bia' na' chbill yag yeja', na' chllib yeja' llian na' yeḻ' mba c̱heyinna' chbiayi'n. Ka'kzan beṉ' wni'ana', yiyol yinite' lao delgens c̱he'na' chone'.
Chakomba beena' chzo chzaki chtiḻe' bittez dii mal. Ḻa' kat' ba wdie' lawinna', Chioza' wi'ene' yeḻ' mban zejḻi kaṉi daa bc̱hebe' wi'e beṉ'ka' chakgakile'ne'.
Nottez beṉ' kat' chza'lallee gone' dii malka', bi chiyaḻ' iṉe': “Chioza' bzoe' dii mali lawa'ni”. Ḻa' Chioza' aga bi dii mal chone' ni bibi dii mal chzoe' lao beṉ' kwenc̱he gone'n.
San daa chzelall'cho goncho dii malan', ḻennan' chgooyeḻaan cho' kwenc̱he ixopcho lawinna'.
Na' daa chzelall'cho dii mala', chxopcho lao saaxyana', na' saaxyana' daa choncho chlliayi'n cho'.
Le' beṉ' bish'dawaa na' le' beṉ' zandawaa, bi siye'z kwinle.
Chioza', beena' zoa yabana' na' bx̱e bsile' yog' diika' chzeeni' xan yabana', ḻen' choṉe' cho' yog'ḻoḻ daa nak dii wen dii shao' na' toshiizi zoe' chone' wen na' biga chillee.

Ḻen' wyazlallee goṉe' yeḻ' mban c̱hecho zejḻi kaṉi daa wyajḻe'cho dill' ḻi c̱he'na', kwenc̱he ladj yog' beṉ'ka' bx̱e bsile' gokcho beṉ' nech beṉ' biya'o bizi'e, na' zaklebicho diika' chizi' chilapgake' dii nech daa chzangakile' choe'gake' Chioza'.
Le' beṉ' bish'dawaa na' le' beṉ' zandawaa, ḻi wzoa yic̱hjle dga: yog'ḻoḻ beṉ' chiyaḻ' wsede' wzenague', na' wsakee bin iṉe', na' gape' to yeḻ' chxenlall' bi illaa iloke'.
Ḻa' yeḻ' chllaa chloka' chllonan goncho ka cheeni Chioza'.

Daan, ḻi c̱hooṉlall' yog'ḻoḻ dii zbanka' chonle na' yog'ḻoḻ dii malka' chonle, na' ḻi wḻex̱j yic̱hjle wzenagle cho'a xtill' Chioza' daa ba ṉezile. Ḻa' ḻennan' napan yeḻ' wak yislan le' kwenc̱he bi kwiayi'le.
Aga to wzenagzcho cho'a xtill' Chiozan', san chiyaḻ' goncho ka nan. Na' shi bi goncho ka nan, chziye'zə kwinchon, shi ṉaa.
Beena' to chzenagz cho'a xtill' Chioza' na' bi chone' ka nan, chone' ka beena' chwia cho'alawe'na' lo wanna',
na' ka chikwase' chiyoll chwia cho'alawe'na', ḻi chaḻ-lall'tie' nakan nake'.
Beena' bi chaḻ-lall' dii wenna' nllia Chioza' bia' gone' daa yisell yiḻaan ḻe' lao dii mala', na' zie'n wṉeyi, na' toshiizi zoa'tip zoashoshe' chone' ka nan, beenan' zoa mbalaz.
Shi no chakzi chone' ka cheeni Chioza', per bi chak gox̱' cho'a ḻolleena', chziye'z kwinen' na' bibi zakii daa ne' chone' ka cheeni Chioza'.

Daa cheeni X̱acho Chioza' goncho na' nxi'n lawe'na', ḻen dga: yiyesh'lallicho bi' wizebdo'ka' na' nool wizebka' lao dii lalljka' chen chle'gakile', na' gap wwia kwincho bi goncho txen dii malka' de yell-lioni.
